title: Normal: the cable company confirms a repair visit

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hi, this is an automated reminder from Coastal Cable. A technician will visit tomorrow between 9 and 11 a.m. to fix your TV service.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh good, it's been out since Monday.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Press 1 to confirm, or press 2 to pick a different time.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you, your visit is confirmed. The technician will show a Coastal Cable badge, and there is no charge for this repair.
